en: AI agents, tools like Claude, can be used
for a broad variety of tasks, for data
science, for research, and of course, for
example, also for software development.
If you're using these tools for software
development, one term you may have heard is
the term agentic engineering,
which is about combining your knowledge as a
software developer
with the capabilities of an AI model to
steer the model in the right direction to
set up guardrails and guidelines the model
or, and the AI agent have to adhere
whilst still
using the broad knowledge and the speed such
an AI agent can bring to the table. So the
idea behind the term agentic engineering is
that you don't throw away your knowledge as
a software developer, but that you instead
leverage it to
tell the AI model or the AI agent what to
do. And you then, of course, reap the
benefits of the the AI agent simply being
much faster at generating the relevant code
and building the software you want to build.
